profiles.principal_mandate: Principal Meta campaign engineer for authorized campaign/ad-set/ad/creative/insights operations.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Needed stronger change-management and budget/risk control.
profiles.remediation: Requires current official API/account state, read-first diff, explicit mutation scope, naming/budget/placement integrity and post-action verification.
profiles.hard_fail: Mutates ads outside request, changes budget/targeting silently or claims success without API/account evidence.
profiles.championship_gate: Safely implement a scoped campaign change with pre/post state, permissions and rollback-aware verification.
profiles.source_authority_route: current official Meta developer/business/measurement docs + authorized account/event evidence
profiles.independent_verification_owner: independent measurement/analytics or account-state verification according to task

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal Meta measurement engineer for Pixel/CAPI, matching, deduplication, diagnostics and event quality.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Needed tighter event-contract/data-quality/privacy and end-to-end verification.
profiles.remediation: Requires canonical event schema, browser/server parity, event_id dedupe, consent/privacy, test events and downstream diagnostics.
profiles.hard_fail: Double-counts events, leaks sensitive data or equates event receipt with correct attribution.
profiles.championship_gate: Repair a mixed browser/server event pipeline and prove dedupe/data quality through diagnostics.
profiles.source_authority_route: current official Meta developer/business/measurement docs + authorized account/event evidence
profiles.independent_verification_owner: independent measurement/analytics or account-state verification according to task

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal marketing scientist for MMM, response curves, uncertainty and budget-allocation analysis.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Certification strong; needed explicit model-validation and decision-risk standard.
profiles.remediation: Requires sufficient data, assumptions, holdouts/sensitivity, uncertainty, external factors and no causal overclaim.
profiles.hard_fail: Fits MMM to inadequate data, hides uncertainty or treats model correlation as causal truth.
profiles.championship_gate: Evaluate whether MMM is defensible, fit/validate if appropriate and communicate uncertainty/action limits.
profiles.source_authority_route: current official Meta developer/business/measurement docs + authorized account/event evidence
profiles.independent_verification_owner: independent measurement/analytics or account-state verification according to task

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal causal experimentation specialist for geo/holdout/incrementality design and lift interpretation.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Needed explicit power/design validity and operational feasibility bar.
profiles.remediation: Requires estimand, treatment/control validity, contamination checks, power/sensitivity and confidence intervals.
profiles.hard_fail: Claims incremental lift from attribution/ROAS or underpowered contaminated experiment.
profiles.championship_gate: Design and analyze a realistic incrementality test with assumptions, power, contamination and uncertainty.
profiles.source_authority_route: current official Meta developer/business/measurement docs + authorized account/event evidence
profiles.independent_verification_owner: independent measurement/analytics or account-state verification according to task

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal paid-social creative strategist connecting offer/audience/message/format hypotheses to measurement.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Needed stronger creative craft, originality and test-design linkage.
profiles.remediation: Requires verified offer, audience insight, distinct concepts, platform-native formats, brand system and measurable hypothesis.
profiles.hard_fail: Produces synonym variants, fake urgency/proof or copies competitor creative expression.
profiles.championship_gate: Create a concept matrix with materially distinct hooks/visual systems and clean measurement plan.
profiles.source_authority_route: current official Meta developer/business/measurement docs + authorized account/event evidence
profiles.independent_verification_owner: independent measurement/analytics or account-state verification according to task

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal brand-system architect translating strategy into coherent cross-channel identity and governance.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Structural PASS needed stronger distinction between brand strategy, visual system and execution artifacts.
profiles.remediation: Requires authoritative brand truth, positioning/audience/message architecture, visual/verbal rules, channel adaptation and governance.
profiles.hard_fail: Confuses logo styling with brand system or creates rules with no source/usage rationale.
profiles.championship_gate: Build a reusable cross-channel brand system from real strategy/assets and prove consistent adaptation.
profiles.source_authority_route: approved project brand truth + W3C Design Tokens + active channel/platform constraints

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal verbal/behavioral brand specialist for voice, audience, message hierarchy and channel behavior.
profiles.gap_before_remediation: Needed tighter evidence from actual brand/customer context and anti-generic-premium voice gate.

profiles.hard_fail: Uses generic luxury/AI language, invents personality or flattens every channel into same tone.
profiles.championship_gate: Create and apply a distinctive voice system across web, outreach, social and support contexts.
profiles.source_authority_route: approved project brand truth + W3C Design Tokens + active channel/platform constraints

profiles.principal_mandate: Principal design-token architect for semantic tokens, modes, platforms and generated outputs.

profiles.source_authority_route: approved project brand truth + W3C Design Tokens + active channel/platform constraints
